requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous flux of the retro-reflector must be within the limits for the night-time colours red, amber or white as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Measure trichromatic coordinates of reflected flux per paragraph 4.2.1.; pass if within R48 night-time red (amber/white) limits.

requirements.text: With respect to photometric performance, the conformity of mass-produced retro-reflective devices shall not be contested if, when testing photometric performances of any retro-reflective device chosen at random, no measured value deviates unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the minimum values prescribed in this Regulation; retro-reflective devices with apparent defects are disregarded.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of a randomly chosen production retro-reflector per the Regulation's photometric procedure; pass if no value is more than 20 % below the prescribed minimum (devices with apparent defects excluded).

requirements.text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices which are not marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes of reference to the position of minimum RI, which must conform to the value specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Rotate unmarked device about reference axis at β1 = β2 = 0° (or paragraph 5 angle), α = 20'; find minimum RI; pass if minimum RI ≥ paragraph 5 value.

requirements.text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 4. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes ±5°, and the RI must not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed by the device during this rotation.
requirements.test_case: Rotate TOP-marked device ±5° about its axis at β1 = β2 = 0°, α = 20'; pass if RI ≥ prescribed value at every position.

requirements.text: For testing the retro-reflection the retro-reflective devices shall be illuminated with a CIE Standard Illuminant A (ISO 11664-2:2007(E)/CIE S 014-2/E:2006) and measured as described in Part 1 of Annex 4.
requirements.test_case: Verify source calibrated to CIE Standard Illuminant A (≈2856 K) and measurement per Annex 4 Part 1.

requirements.text: The shape of the illuminating surfaces of retro-reflective devices of Class IA or IB shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection from an observation distance of 10 m: the illuminating surface shape is not easily confused with the triangular shape of Class IIIA/IIIB retro-reflectors.

requirements.text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors of retro-reflecting devices of Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA, SMV and advance warning triangle of type 1, the retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C, after which the sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 °C.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 1 para. 1: condition the retro-reflector for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at 65 °C ± 2 °C, then cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 °C; record conditioning log showing compliance with durations and temperatures, then examine per para. 3.

requirements.text: After the resistance to heat test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component must be visible.
requirements.test_case: Following the heat conditioning of Annex 6 Part 1, visually inspect the retro-reflective device and its optical component; pass if no cracking and no appreciable distortion is visible.

requirements.text: After the water penetration test, no water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 2 para. 1.2: after immersion sequence, inspect reflecting surface; pass if no water has reached the reflecting surface.

requirements.text: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the retro-reflective device shall not be considered to have passed the water penetration test.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 2 para. 1.2: visual inspection after immersion; any clearly visible water inside the optical unit = fail.

requirements.text: If the retro-reflector is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling or lighting functions, these functions shall be operated at design voltage during the water spray test according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate) and 55 min OFF.
requirements.test_case: Energise the rear position, stop and reversing functions at design voltage on a 5 min ON / 55 min OFF cycle. Pass: the cycle is applied throughout the test.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the drain period, the interior of the device shall be observed for moisture accumulation, and no standing pool of water shall be allowed to be formed, or be formable by tapping or tilting the device.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the interior, then tap and tilt the device. Pass: no standing pool of water is present or formed.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices must be so designed that they retain the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which they are normally exposed.
requirements.test_case: Corrosion test per Annex 6 Part 4 (ISO 9227:2017 saline mist); afterwards verify photometric (RA) and colorimetric characteristics remain within prescribed limits.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device, or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
requirements.test_case: Remove all removable parts from the combined lamp; expose to saline mist 24 h, dry 2 h, expose 24 h (50 h total); record exposure timing.

requirements.text: In the case of retro-reflective devices with essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C, a saline solution obtained by dissolving 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.
requirements.test_case: Verify salt spray chamber at 35 °C ± 2 °C with 5 % NaCl solution by weight in distilled water with ≤ 0.02 % impurities.

requirements.text: Immediately after completion of the corrosion test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection immediately after 50 h saline mist test; pass if no excessive corrosion liable to impair device efficiency.

requirements.text: After the corrosion test, the coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9 or more than the value in Table 10 respectively.
requirements.test_case: After 48 h recovery, measure RA per Annex 6 Part 2 at β2 = 5°, α = 20'; pass if RA ≥ Table 9 minimum and ≤ Table 10 maximum.

requirements.text: After about five minutes following the wipe with the fuel test mixture, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall be inspected visually and must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
requirements.test_case: Annex 7 Part 1, para. 1.1(b): about 5 min after the wipe, inspect visually. Pass: no apparent surface changes; slight surface cracks are acceptable.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation on the vehicle and run a vibration / durability evaluation under normal conditions of use (para. 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1., 2.3.10.2.). Then re-check the photometry, colour and geometric visibility of the rear position, stop and reversing lamps and the retro-reflector. Pass if the lamp stays securely mounted and all prescribed characteristics remain met.

requirements.text: It shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the mounting and fixing means, then apply normal handling, operational loads and vibration. Pass if the lamp position and orientation cannot change unintentionally without deliberate use of tools, and the aim and orientation are unchanged after the test.

requirements.text: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road, with a tolerance of ±3° allowed.
requirements.test_case: Measure the angle between each function's reference axis and the vehicle's bearing plane on the road, with the lamp installed on the vehicle; pass if the axis is parallel within ±3°.

requirements.text: The reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle in the case of all signalling devices other than side retro-reflectors and side-marker lamps, with a tolerance of ±3° allowed.
requirements.test_case: Measure the angle between each function's reference axis and the vehicle's median longitudinal plane, with the lamp installed on the vehicle; pass if the axis is parallel within ±3°.

requirements.text: The reference axis of side retro-reflectors and of side-marker lamps when fitted to the vehicle shall be perpendicular to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, with a tolerance of ±3° allowed.
requirements.test_case: Measure the angle between the reference axis of any side retro-reflector or side-marker lamp and the vehicle's median longitudinal plane, with the device installed on the vehicle; pass if the axis is perpendicular within ±3°.

requirements.text: Any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer of the light-signalling device shall be complied with.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation against the manufacturer's fitting instructions; pass if all specified fitting instructions are met.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.).
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection/measurement: measure lateral positions of the exterior geometrical form of left and right lamps relative to the median longitudinal plane; pass if mirror-symmetric within measurement tolerance.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane; this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Compare left and right lamp external geometry (CAD/visual inspection); pass if exterior shapes are mirror images about the median longitudinal plane (interior structure excluded).

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of each function on left and right lamps per the applicable device regulation; pass if both lamps of the pair meet the same colour requirements (red for rear position/stop/retro-reflector, white for reversing).

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics. This shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of each function on left and right lamps at the prescribed test points; pass if intensity distributions are substantially identical (not required for a matched pair).

requirements.text: In case of lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the rear of the vehicle and only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of vehicle rear and front; pass if at most one logo per side or one central logo is incorporated in lamps on each of the rear and front.

requirements.text: All logos incorporated in lamps that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos are prohibited.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of lamp logos; pass if any logo is solely a vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logo.

requirements.text: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical, the requirements of the preceding paragraphs on the installation of lighting and light-signalling devices shall be satisfied so far as is possible.
requirements.test_case: Installation inspection per UN R48: if the vehicle's external shape is asymmetrical, check lamp positioning and symmetry against the preceding installation requirements. Pass if they are met, or if any deviation is caused only by the asymmetrical body shape and is kept to the minimum possible.

requirements.text: Lamps may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of the installed lamp and verification against each applicable colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility and electrical connection requirement of UN R48 for every grouped/combined/reciprocally incorporated function; pass if all are met.

requirements.text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
requirements.test_case: Photometric and colorimetric measurement of each function individually with all other grouped/combined/reciprocally incorporated functions switched OFF; pass if each meets its photometric and colour requirements.

requirements.text: When a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of each reciprocally incorporated function with that function and the rear position lamp switched ON simultaneously; pass if the colour of each function remains within its specified chromaticity limits.

requirements.text: Stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps are not permitted to be reciprocally incorporated.
requirements.test_case: Design review/inspection of the lamp: verify the stop lamp does not share illuminating surface/light source/body in a reciprocally incorporated manner with any direction-indicator lamp; pass if not reciprocally incorporated.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that either (a) the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis; or (b) the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis. These requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.test_case: Geometric analysis of apparent surface projection in direction of the reference axis: pass if filled area ≥ 60 % of circumscribing quadrilateral, or gap between facing edges ≤ 75 mm measured perpendicular to the reference axis.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
requirements.test_case: Geometric analysis per paragraph 5.7.2.1 (≥ 60 % fill of circumscribing quadrilateral or ≤ 75 mm gap between facing edges).

requirements.text: Where two or more lamps and/or two or more separate apparent surfaces are included into the same lamp body and/or have a common outer lens these shall not be considered as an interdependent lamp system; however, a lamp in the shape of a band or strip may be part of an interdependent lamp system.
requirements.test_case: Design review: verify that lamps/apparent surfaces sharing the same housing or common outer lens are not declared as an interdependent lamp system unless band/strip-shaped.

requirements.text: Where the (maximum and minimum) height of the lamp above the ground clearly meets the requirements of the Regulation, the exact edges of any surface need not be determined.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of vehicle installation: if the lamp height is clearly within the R48 limits with margin, confirm acceptance without exact edge determination of the apparent surface.

requirements.text: Where the position of the lamp as regards width clearly meets the requirements of the Regulation, the exact edges of any surface need not be determined.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of vehicle installation: if lateral position is clearly within R48 limits with margin, confirm acceptance without exact edge determination.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Switch each function ON at nominal voltage and monitor luminous intensity, colour and apparent surface over the ON period; pass if no intentional variation occurs (only variations permitted under paragraph 5.9.2).

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary in relation to the ambient light, as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, or when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: For each permitted variation condition implemented (ambient light, other lamps ON/OFF, combined function), measure photometry in each state; pass if each state complies with the photometric/colorimetric provisions of the lamp's component regulation.

requirements.text: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle-level visibility check per paragraph 5.10.4.1 (Zone 1, transverse plane 25 m in front, Annex 4); pass if no red light from the rear lamp is visible from the front.

requirements.text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.test_case: Geometric/CAD or physical sightline check per Annex 4: observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane 25 m in front of the vehicle; pass if no part of the apparent surface of any red lamp is directly visible.

requirements.text: For the visibility of white light towards the rear of a vehicle, with the exception of reversing lamps and white side conspicuity markings, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a white lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 2 in a transverse plane situated 25 m behind the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.test_case: Sightline check per Annex 4: observer moving within Zone 2 in a transverse plane 25 m behind the vehicle; pass if no apparent surface of a white lamp other than reversing lamps and white side conspicuity markings is directly visible.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection and functional check: operate the lighting switch in all positions and verify that the rear position lamp is never ON while the front position lamps, the end-outline and side-marker lamps (if fitted) or the rear registration plate lamp are OFF, and vice versa. Pass if all switch ON and OFF simultaneously.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.test_case: Where any function is an interdependent lamp system: activate and deactivate the function and verify (visually or by current/photometric measurement on each unit) that all light sources of all interdependent lamps switch ON and OFF simultaneously.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates (x,y) of the reversing lamp light output by colorimetry/spectroradiometry with the lamp energised at nominal conditions through the outer lens; pass if the coordinates lie within the white chromaticity boundaries defined in the regulation.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates (x,y) of the stop lamp light output through the outer lens with the lamp energised at nominal conditions; pass if the coordinates lie within the red chromaticity boundaries defined in the regulation.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates (x,y) of the rear position lamp light output through the outer lens with the lamp energised at nominal conditions; pass if the coordinates lie within the red chromaticity boundaries defined in the regulation.

requirements.text: The colour of the light reflected by a non-triangular rear retro-reflector shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Illuminate the rear retro-reflector with standard illuminant A and measure the chromaticity coordinates of the reflected light; pass if the coordinates lie within the red chromaticity boundaries defined in the regulation.

requirements.text: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of the vehicle installation: count the installed rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors and compare each count against the number specified in the individual specifications of UN R48 (paragraph 6) for the vehicle category; pass if every count equals the specified number.

requirements.text: Any lamp may be installed on movable components provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Installation inspection: if any function of the rear combination lamp is mounted on a movable component, verify compliance with the conditions of paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. Pass if all conditions are met; otherwise the lamp shall be mounted on a fixed part of the vehicle.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps, rear direction-indicators and rear retro-reflectors, triangular as well as non-triangular, may be installed on movable components only if at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.
requirements.test_case: Installation check on vehicle: place movable component in each fixed position (closed and every fixed open position); verify mounting position, geometric visibility angles, colour and photometric values of rear position lamp and retro-reflector per UN R48 and device regulation. Pass: all requirements met at every fixed position.

requirements.text: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
requirements.test_case: Installation inspection per UN R48 para. 5.19: place the movable component (e.g. tailgate) in each position other than the normal position of use, with the lamp functions activated; verify that no device installed on it causes undue discomfort (e.g. glare or misleading signals) to road users. Pass if no undue discomfort is found in any such position.

requirements.text: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Installation check per UN R48: with the lamp on the movable component, move the component out of and back into the normal position(s) of use several times. After each return, measure the lamp position and orientation (mounting height, lateral position, geometric visibility angles) and compare them with the manufacturer's specified position(s). Pass if the lamp returns to the specified position(s) every time and the R48 installation requirements are still met.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use"; fixed position of a movable component means the stable or natural rest position(s) of the movable component specified by the vehicle manufacturer, whether locked or not.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: place each movable component (e.g. tailgate, boot lid) in every manufacturer-specified stable or natural rest position other than normal position of use; measure the apparent surface of the rear position lamp and retro-reflector in the direction of the reference axis; pass if no more than 50 per cent is hidden, otherwise para. 5.21.1 or 5.21.2 compliance must be shown.

requirements.text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21 is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle test: move the movable component to each position where more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface is hidden; verify the additional lamps switch ON automatically and verify their position, geometric visibility, colour and photometry against the requirements for the lamp replaced; pass if all are met.

requirements.text: With the exception of retro-reflectors, a lamp, even bearing an approval mark, is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse; each lamp function shall therefore be capable of being made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of the vehicle installation and electrical schematic: with the light source(s) and fuse(s) fitted, activate each lamp function (rear position, stop, reversing) via its vehicle control; pass if each lamp operates without any further wiring, connector or component additions. Lamps not operable in this way are treated as not present.

requirements.text: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is allowed only provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of the rear position lamp function; verify the replacement function emits light of the same colour (red, colorimetric check), similar main intensity (photometric measurement against rear position lamp values) and from a similar position (mounting geometry check).

requirements.text: Where a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is provided, the replacement device shall remain operational in its original safety function.
requirements.test_case: With the rear position lamp function failed and the replacement active, activate the replacement device's original function (e.g. stop lamp); verify it operates and meets its photometric requirements.

requirements.text: During temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle-level test: induce rear position lamp failure; verify the dashboard tell-tale illuminates for the whole duration of the replacement indicating temporary replacement and need for repair.

requirements.text: Rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b, rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, which respond simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., are allowed provided that the intensity of all these lamps, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
requirements.test_case: Activate each variable-intensity trigger condition and measure luminous intensity of all combined/grouped/reciprocally incorporated R2, S2 and 2b lamps over the variation; pass if all vary simultaneously, in the same manner and in similar proportion.

requirements.text: For rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b, rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, in the entire intensity range the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of the paired lamps (e.g. stop/position ratio) at multiple points throughout the intensity range and during transitions; pass if the prescribed ratio is maintained at all points.

requirements.text: No sharp variation of intensity of variable-intensity lamps shall be observed during transition.
requirements.test_case: Record luminous intensity versus time during each transition with a photometer; pass if the change is gradual with no observable step or abrupt jump.

requirements.text: It may be possible for the driver to set the variable luminous intensity functions to static luminous intensities.
requirements.test_case: If provided, verify the driver control sets the lamps to static intensity and that the static intensity is within the prescribed photometric limits.

requirements.text: For vehicles of M and N categories, the electric power supply conditions for the devices indicated in 2.5.1., 2.5.2., 2.5.4., 2.5.6. and 2.5.7. shall comply with the provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. to 5.27.3. when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, representative for the relevant category of powered vehicle as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Demonstrate to the Technical Service with the vehicle electrical system in a constant voltage operating condition representative of the vehicle category; pass if the terminal voltages meet 5.27.1/5.27.2 or the device is exempt under 5.27.3.

requirements.text: The voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.
requirements.test_case: Measure voltage at the lamp terminals under constant voltage operating condition; pass if it does not exceed the voltage stated in the device's type approval documentation.

requirements.text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V by more than 3 per cent for 6 Volt-Systems.
requirements.test_case: Measure terminal voltage under constant voltage operating condition; pass if ≤ 6.75 V + 3 %.

requirements.text: The means of controlling the maximum voltage at the terminals of the device may, for convenience, be located within the body of the device.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of design: where the voltage limiting means is integrated in the lamp body, verify terminal-voltage compliance is still demonstrated.

requirements.text: The provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. and 5.27.2. shall not apply to devices which include an electronic light source control gear, or a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
requirements.test_case: Review of device design and approval documentation; exemption applies if the lamp contains electronic light source control gear, an integrated variable intensity control, or only UN R128 approved light sources.

requirements.text: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity. However, no account is taken of obstacles, if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.
requirements.test_case: Installation inspection: check each function's apparent surface across its prescribed geometric visibility angles, observed from infinity, for obstruction by vehicle parts. Obstacles already present at lamp type-approval are disregarded. Pass if no obstruction is found.

requirements.text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of the installed lamp with the vehicle obstruction present, or simulated by masking. Pass if the unobstructed part meets the photometric values prescribed in the device approval regulation for each function.

requirements.text: When the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal may be reduced to 5° (lamp at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5° below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Measure the mounting height per paragraph 5.8.1. If it is below 750 mm and the regulation permits a 5° reduction, the photometric field may be limited to 5° below horizontal. Pass if photometry is met within the applicable field.

requirements.text: A LED module does not need to be replaceable, if so stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval.
requirements.test_case: Document review: check the component type approval communication sheet of the rear combination lamp. Pass if the LED modules are replaceable, or if the sheet explicitly states that the LED module is non-replaceable.

requirements.text: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Document review: for each function (rear position, stop, reversing lamp, retro-reflector), verify a valid type approval and approval marking according to the device Regulation specified in the relevant subparagraph of paragraph 6 of UN R48 (e.g. UN R148 for signalling lamps, UN R150 for retro-reflectors, as referenced). Pass if every function installed on the vehicle is covered by a valid approval.

requirements.text: Especially in case of light-signalling lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp and drawings for an incorporated manufacturer logo; if present, verify that the lamp holds a type approval according to UN Regulation No. 148 covering the logo-incorporating configuration. Pass if the approval exists and the approval mark is present on the lamp.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be present on motor vehicles and on trailers of categories O2, O3 and O4; it is optional on trailers of category O1.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify at least one reversing lamp function is fitted on the M1 vehicle; pass if present.

requirements.text: One reversing lamp device is mandatory and a second device optional on motor vehicles of category M1 and on all other vehicles with a length not exceeding 6,000 mm.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: count reversing lamp devices; pass if 1 or 2 devices are fitted.

requirements.text: Reversing lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Document and marking check: verify valid R23 or R148 (00 or later series) approval and corresponding approval mark on the lamp; pass if present.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in height not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground; for category N2G, N3G, M2G, M3G (off-road) vehicles the maximum height may be increased to 1,400 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure height of the illuminating surface above ground on the vehicle in unladen condition; pass if 250 mm ≤ height ≤ 1,200 mm (1,400 mm max for N2G, N3G, M2G, M3G).

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle; however, if installed, the two optional devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. may be fitted on the side of the vehicle, provided that the requirements of paragraphs 6.4.5.2. and 6.4.6.2. are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the reversing lamp is installed at the rear of the vehicle; pass if rear-mounted.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle, defined by angle α as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., shall be α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check per paragraph 2.10.7. on installed lamp: verify unobstructed apparent surface from 15° up to 5° down; pass if visible over full range.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of a reversing lamp installed at the rear of the vehicle, defined by angle β as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., shall be β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check per paragraph 2.10.7. with a single reversing lamp: verify unobstructed visibility 45° left and 45° right; pass if visible over full range.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of reversing lamps installed at the rear of the vehicle, defined by angle β as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., shall be β = 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two devices.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check per paragraph 2.10.7. with two reversing lamps: verify unobstructed visibility 45° outwards and 30° inwards for each lamp; pass if visible over full range.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the reference axis of the reversing lamp is directed rearwards; pass if oriented rearwards.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the reversing lamp shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Functional test on vehicle: engage reverse with propulsion system operable; pass if lamp switches ON only under both conditions.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either the reverse gear is not engaged or the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is not in a position where operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Functional test on vehicle: disengage reverse, and separately switch propulsion system off with reverse engaged; pass if lamp does not switch ON or switches OFF in each case.

requirements.text: A tell-tale for the reversing lamp is optional; however, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check R23/R148 approval for failure-indication requirements; if required, simulate LED failure and verify the failure tell-tale activates.

requirements.text: Stop lamp devices of S1 or S2 categories are mandatory on all categories of vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify S1 or S2 category stop lamps are fitted; pass if present.

requirements.text: The number of stop lamps shall be two S1 or S2 category devices and one S3 or S4 category device on all categories of vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: count stop lamp devices by category; pass if two S1/S2 devices (left and right rear combination lamps) and one S3/S4 device are fitted.

requirements.text: The stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Document and marking check: verify approval mark and certificate to UN R7 02+ series or UN R148 00+ series for the stop function category S1/S2; pass if valid approval exists.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, for S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices, the point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle; for the distance in between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes there is no special requirement.
requirements.test_case: Measure on vehicle the lateral distance from outermost point of stop lamp apparent surface (in reference axis direction) to extreme outer edge of vehicle; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

requirements.text: S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be mounted above the ground not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure height of apparent surface above ground per paragraph 5.8.1 on unladen vehicle; pass if lower edge ≥ 350 mm and upper edge ≤ 1,500 mm (or ≤ 2,100 mm where bodywork justifies and no optional lamps).

requirements.text: If the optional S1 or S2 category stop lamps are installed, they shall be positioned at a height compatible with the requirements of the width and the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.
requirements.test_case: Where optional stop lamps are fitted, measure vertical distance to mandatory stop lamps; pass if ≥ 600 mm and width/symmetry requirements met.

requirements.text: S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: pass if stop lamps are located at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be, in the horizontal angle, 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle; however, for stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check of apparent surface on vehicle: verify unobstructed view over 45° outboard and 45° inboard (or 20° inboard below H plane if mounted below 750 mm); pass if visibility requirements met.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be, in the vertical angle, 15° above and below the horizontal; however, (a) where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°; (b) where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on vehicle: verify unobstructed view 15° up and 15° down (5° down if mounted below 750 mm; 5° up for optional lamp above 2,100 mm); pass if met.

requirements.text: The stop lamps shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Installation inspection: verify reference axis of stop lamp points rearward; pass if oriented towards the rear.

requirements.text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.test_case: Functional test on vehicle: apply brake signal per UN R13/R13-H; pass if all stop lamps illuminate simultaneously.

requirements.text: A tell-tale for the stop lamps is optional; however, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check component approval (UN R7/R148) for failure tell-tale requirement; if required, simulate stop lamp failure and verify tell-tale indication; pass if provided where required.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps of the R or R1 or R2 categories shall be mandatorily installed on the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify rear position lamps of category R, R1 or R2 are fitted; pass if present.

requirements.text: The number of rear position lamps shall be two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Inspect vehicle and approval markings: pass if exactly two mandatory rear position lamps are fitted, each bearing a valid R7 (02 series or later) or R148 (00 series or later) approval.

requirements.text: In width, the point on the apparent surface of the rear position lamp in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle; this condition shall not apply to the optional rear lamps.
requirements.test_case: Measure on vehicle the lateral distance from the outermost point of the apparent surface (reference axis direction) to the vehicle extreme outer edge; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

requirements.text: The distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces of the rear position lamps in the direction of the reference axes shall have no special requirement for M1 and N1 category vehicles; for all other categories of vehicles it shall be not less than 600 mm, which may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.
requirements.test_case: For M1/N1: no check required. For other categories: measure distance between inner edges of the apparent surfaces; pass if ≥ 600 mm (≥ 400 mm if overall width < 1,300 mm).

requirements.text: In height, the rear position lamps shall be mounted above the ground not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure height of apparent surface above ground per para. 5.8.1 with vehicle unladen; pass if 350 mm ≤ h ≤ 1,500 mm (or ≤ 2,100 mm where bodywork justifies and no optional lamps fitted).

requirements.text: If the optional rear position lamps are installed, they shall be placed at a height compatible with the applicable requirements of paragraph 6.10.4.1., the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.
requirements.test_case: Where optional lamps fitted: measure vertical distance between optional and mandatory lamps; pass if ≥ 600 mm and lateral position complies with 6.10.4.1 and lamps are symmetrical.

requirements.text: In length, the rear position lamps shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of installation: pass if lamps are located at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall be, in the horizontal angle, 45° inwards and 80° outwards; however, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on vehicle: verify unobstructed view of apparent surface over 45° inboard to 80° outboard (20° inboard below H plane if mounted < 750 mm); pass if visible throughout.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall be, in the vertical angle, 15° above and below the horizontal; however, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.) the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°, and where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on vehicle: verify unobstructed view over 15° up and 15° down (5° down if mounted < 750 mm; 5° up for optional lamp > 2,100 mm); pass if visible throughout.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the horizontal angle of geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall be 45° outwards to 45° inwards; however, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: If alternative used: confirm rear side-marker lamp fitted; verify visibility 45° inboard to 45° outboard (20° inboard below H plane if mounted < 750 mm); pass if visible throughout.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles using the alternative of paragraph 6.10.5.2., the vertical angle of geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall be 15° above and below the horizontal; however, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: If alternative used: verify visibility over 15° up and down (5° down if mounted < 750 mm); pass if visible throughout.

requirements.text: To be considered visible under paragraph 6.10.5.2., the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres; the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light shall be excluded.
requirements.test_case: At each boundary direction of the alternative visibility field, measure unobstructed projected apparent surface excluding non-transmitting retro-reflector area; pass if ≥ 12.5 cm².

requirements.text: The orientation of the rear position lamps shall be rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspect installation: pass if reference axis of the lamp is directed rearwards.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the rear position lamps shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11; however, if a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a direction-indicator, the electrical connection of the rear position lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle or the reciprocally incorporated part of it may be such that it is switched OFF during the entire time (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the direction-indicator lamp.
requirements.test_case: Functional electrical test on vehicle: verify switching per para. 5.11 (with front position lamps, end-outline and registration plate lamps as applicable); if reciprocally incorporated with direction indicator, verify any switch-off covers whole indicator operation only.

requirements.text: A closed-circuit tell-tale shall be mandatory for the rear position lamps and shall be combined with that of the front position lamps; this requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON. However, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Switch on position lamps and check instrument cluster: pass if combined front/rear position closed-circuit tell-tale illuminates (not required while DRL on); verify failure tell-tale where component regulation requires.

requirements.text: Rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be mandatory on motor vehicles; provided that they are grouped together with the other rear light-signalling devices, they are optional on trailers.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify presence of rear non-triangular retro-reflectors on the M1 vehicle; pass if fitted.

requirements.text: The number of rear non-triangular retro-reflectors shall be two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.test_case: Check that two rear retro-reflectors are fitted and carry valid Class IA or IB approval marks per UN R3 (02 series or later) or UN R150 (00 series or later); pass if both comply.

requirements.text: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4.) are permitted provided they do not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of any additional retro-reflecting devices/materials; pass if mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices' effectiveness is not impaired.

requirements.text: In width, the point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure lateral distance from outermost point of illuminating surface to extreme outer edge of vehicle; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

requirements.text: The distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces of the rear retro-reflectors in the direction of the reference axes shall have no special requirement for M1 and N1 category vehicles; for all other categories of vehicles it shall be not less than 600 mm, which may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure distance between inner edges of apparent surfaces of the two retro-reflectors; for M1/N1 no limit; other categories pass if ≥ 600 mm (≥ 400 mm if overall width < 1,300 mm).

requirements.text: In height, the rear retro-reflector shall be above the ground not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1,200 mm respectively).
requirements.test_case: Measure height of illuminating surface above ground with vehicle unladen per para 5.8.1; pass if 250 mm ≤ h ≤ 900 mm, or ≤ 1,200 mm when grouped with rear lamps, or ≤ 1,500 mm where bodywork shape prevents compliance.

requirements.text: In length, the rear retro-reflector shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection; pass if retro-reflector is located at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector shall be: horizontal angle 30° inwards and outwards.
requirements.test_case: Verify unobstructed visibility of the illuminating surface over 30° inwards and 30° outwards from the reference axis; pass if no obstruction.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector shall be: vertical angle 10° above and below horizontal; however, where the retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify unobstructed visibility over 10° up and 10° down (5° down if mounting height < 750 mm per 5.8.1); pass if no obstruction.

requirements.text: The orientation of the rear retro-reflector shall be rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of installed lamp; pass if retro-reflector reference axis faces rearwards.

requirements.text: The illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector may have parts in common with the apparent surface of any other lamp situated at the rear.
requirements.test_case: Design review: shared surfaces between retro-reflector and other rear lamp functions permitted; no fail criterion.

requirements.text: For the verification of paragraph 5.10.4. (no red light visible to the front and no white light visible to the rear), zones 1 and 2 explored by the eye of the observer shall be bounded in height by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m respectively above the ground, and in width by two vertical planes which, forming to the front and to the rear respectively an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane, pass through the point or points of contact of vertical planes parallel to the vehicle's median longitudinal plane delimiting the vehicle's overall width; if there are several points of contact, the foremost shall correspond to the forward plane and the rearmost to the rearward plane.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation check per Annex 4: vehicle on substantially horizontal ground, lamps switched on. Observe from zone 1 (front) and zone 2 (rear), bounded by heights of 1 m to 2.2 m above ground and by vertical planes at 15° outwards from the median longitudinal plane through the overall-width contact points. Pass: no red light from the rear combination lamp is directly visible from zone 1, and no white light other than that permitted by paragraph 5.10 (e.g. the reversing lamp) is directly visible from zone 2.
